title: scribbit-mcp environment
description: Environment of the HTTP server (src/main.ts, parsed by src/config.ts) and, where noted, the stdio entry point (src/stdio.ts). Values are strings, as in any environment. API keys are configured as SHA-256 hashes only; the key itself is printed once by `pnpm --filter @bsh/scribbit-mcp mint-key` and never stored.

MCP_PUBLIC_URL.description: Absolute base URL clients use (behind the edge). Advertised as the MCP endpoint on GET /.

MCP_NETWORKS.description: Comma-separated networks the tools serve (mainnet, testnet, signet, regtest). HTTP default: mainnet. stdio default: all four.

MCP_API_KEY_ENV.description: Only keys of this environment are accepted; configured keys of the other environment are a startup error.

MCP_REQUIRE_API_KEY.description: false lets anonymous callers use /mcp. Local development only; a bad key still fails.

MCP_API_KEYS_JSON.description: JSON array of key records: [{"id","hash" (lower-case hex SHA-256 of the key),"env","scopes":["mcp"],"ownerId"?,"name"?,"expiresAt"? (epoch ms),"revokedAt"?,"quota"?:{"limit","windowMs"}}]. A record with a plaintext "key" field is refused. Secret path: services/scribbit-mcp/api-key-hashes.

MCP_API_KEYS_FILE.description: Path to a file with the same JSON array (merged with MCP_API_KEYS_JSON).

MCP_FEE_URL_MAINNET.description: Fee source for mainnet: a scribb.it fee server URL ending in /v1/fees (contracts/openapi/scribbit-fees.yaml) or a mempool.space-compatible base URL. Default https://mempool.space. `off` disables the oracle: get_fees fails and quote_inscription needs feeRate. Also read by the stdio entry point.

MCP_FEE_URL_REGTEST.description: As above for regtest (no public default: unset means no oracle).

MCP_TRUSTED_PROXIES.description: Comma-separated CIDRs of proxies we run. X-Forwarded-For is read only from them (client IP for rate limits). Leave unset when the service is reachable directly.

MCP_CORS_ORIGINS.description: Comma-separated browser origins allowed to call the API. Default none (MCP clients are not browsers).

MCP_RATE_LIMIT_IP_PER_MIN.description: Token bucket per client IP, every route.

MCP_RATE_LIMIT_KEY_PER_MIN.description: Token bucket per API key on /mcp.

MCP_MAX_BODY_BYTES.description: POST body limit (413 above). 8 MiB fits one 4 MiB inscription body in base64.
